Container.Name: rabbithole
Container.Overview: Music discovery from your own listening. Reads ListenBrainz (scrobbled from Navidrome), ranks suggestions with AudioMuse, builds per-user Navidrome playlists and requests missing albums through Lidarr.

Config.Name: Postgres connection string
Config.Description: Postgres database for Rabbithole. The database is created and migrated on first start.

Config.Name: JWT key
Config.Description: Random string, at least 32 characters. Changing it signs everyone out.

Config.Name: Navidrome URL
Config.Description: Used for sign-in, library matching and playlists

Config.Name: AudioMuse URL
Config.Description: Optional: ranks suggestions by how they sound

Config.Name: AudioMuse API token
Config.Description: Optional: AudioMuse's API_TOKEN if it has auth turned on

Config.Name: Weekly request cap
Config.Description: Max albums each user can send to Lidarr per week

Config.Name: Hangfire username
Config.Description: Login for the job dashboard at /hangfire

Config.Name: Hangfire password
Config.Description: Password for the job dashboard at /hangfire
